Findings
· f-002  ● A packaged gh build reports as "unavailable" rather than as a version
         pending · blocking · suggestion · confidence low · severity major ·
         verified plausible · src/cli.ts:598
         The regex requires whitespace or end-of-line immediately after the
         patch number, so a packaged build with a suffix is reported as
         unavailable.
         Impact
         Every packaged build is reported as unavailable, so the version gate
         never passes on a release machine.
         Suggested fix
         ┃ const m = /^gh version (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/.exec(line);
         References
         https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/1

✓ f-001  Alias metadata removed from three skills, still live in four others
         accepted · issue · confidence medium ·
         adapters/pi/skills/post-review/SKILL.md:10
         This change removes `metadata.aliases` from three skills and justifies
         it in both READMEs. By that premise, the four skills that still declare
         it are dead configuration whose advertised names never resolve.

✗ f-003  Authority clause quotes a README phrase to satisfy a substring test
         excluded · general
         The clause exists to pass the test, not to state a rule.
